summary: Backend (6/6) and frontend (all listed flows) tested for Sportily Tourism landing site + inquiries API. All critical flows work: POST /api/inquiries with valid/invalid/missing payloads returns expected 200/422; GET /api/inquiries returns list sorted newest-first with no _id leak; landing page loads with all sections; Navbar and Hero CTAs scroll to contact form; empty submit shows error toast; valid submit shows contact-success and success toast.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 on create; spec mentioned '201-style'. Not a functional bug but consider status_code=201 for semantic correctness.

logger is used inside create_inquiry but defined AFTER app.include_router; works at runtime because logger is only invoked at request time, but declaration order is fragile — move logging.basicConfig/getLogger before route registration.

action_items: (Optional) Reorder logger init before route usage in server.py
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger declared after include_router (works but fragile).
InquiryCreate has no length caps on name/message — consider max_length to prevent abuse on public endpoint.
No rate limiting on public POST /api/inquiries — spam risk in production.
CORS defaults to '*' via env; fine for MVP but restrict for production.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ prefixed inquiries inserted into MongoDB via API (test_john@example.com, test_min@example.com). Safe to leave; prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/inquiries (POST, GET) and /api/ root confirmed working against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend testids verified: hero-quote-btn, hero-events-btn, nav-quote-btn, contact-form, input-name, input-email, input-message, contact-submit-btn, contact-success, select-event (native <select>). Lenis smooth-scroll requires ~2s wait after clicking scroll CTAs before checking viewport.
